registration.statement: An admitted channel is a complete canonical input carrier, complete output carrier and held source-bound transport relation giving every input at least one output. Inputs are confusable exactly when their output supports overlap. A zero-error code is a held input selection with pairwise disjoint output supports. Exact channel capacity is the complete family of greatest-cardinality distinguishable codes, with all ties retained; composition is relational path composition at an equal interface.
registration.title: Exact finite channels, confusability and capacity
